description: Add a text animator (Animation > Animate Text) with its properties (position, scale, rotation, opacity, fill colour, tracking, blur, character value, variable font axes, All Transform Properties...) and selectors (Animation > Add Text Selector: Range, Wiggly, Expression) with their settings; or add properties and selectors to an existing animator, or change an existing selector. A new animator without selectors gets a Range selector, as in the Animate menu

animator.description: An existing animator to change: its 1-based index or name (list_text_animators). Omit to add a new animator

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

fontAxes.description: Variable font axes to animate (Animate Text > Variable Font Axes)

tag.description: Four-letter axis tag, e.g. "wght" or "wdth" (find_fonts lists a font's axes)

value.description: Axis value; omit for the default

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

properties.description: Animator properties to add (or set, when already there), each to a value or true for its default. Numbers or [x, y, z] arrays; *_color take "#RRGGBB". Keys: anchor_point, position, scale, skew, skew_axis, rotation, x_rotation, y_rotation, opacity, fill_color, fill_hue, fill_saturation, fill_brightness, fill_opacity, stroke_color, stroke_hue, stroke_saturation, stroke_brightness, stroke_opacity, stroke_width, line_anchor, line_spacing, tracking, character_offset, character_value, blur, all_transform (true: All Transform Properties)

selectors.description: Selectors to add, or with selector: n, to change

basedOn.description: What the selection counts (Advanced > Based On)

expression.description: Expression: the Amount expression, e.g. "selectorValue * textIndex/textTotal"

mode.description: How the selector combines with those above it

randomizeOrder.description: Range: select characters in random order

selector.description: Change the animator's existing selector at this 1-based index instead of adding one

shape.description: Range: how characters between Start and End are selected

start.description: Range: Start, percent or index depending on units

units.description: Start, End and Offset in percentage or index (Advanced > Units)

name: set_text_animator
title: Set Text Animator
